news.text: Welcome to Railfever! Connect the towns of this region with rail and bus lines. Press F1 for a quick guide.
Blue Valley Transit starts coaches between Fairby and St. Challey.
Crimson Express starts coaches between Fairby and Stoneport.
Blue Valley Transit opens a tram line in Fairby.
Crimson Express starts coaches between St. Challey and Stoneport.
Evergreen Lines opens a railway between Fairby and Stoneport (1.5 km).
Blue Valley Transit opens a tram line in St. Challey.
Violet Coast Railways starts coaches between St. Challey and Rockbridge.
Northern Star Rail runs trains on Evergreen Lines's railway between Stoneport and Fairby (track access).
Evergreen Lines rebuilds the stations of R1 Stoneport – Fairby with longer platforms.
